Package viewModel

Class LiveOrdersViewModel

java.lang.Object
viewModel.LiveOrdersViewModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
PropertyChangeListener, EventListener
public class LiveOrdersViewModel extends Object implements PropertyChangeListener
ViewModel for the Live Orders screen.

Provides observable access to active orders and supports interaction such as progressing order states, removing orders, and resolving ingredient customization differences for UI rendering.
